subagents.name: research-helper
subagents.description: Quick lookups + summarisation for the Planner. Latency-sensitive: the subagent is invoked synchronously while the Planner is thinking.
subagents.systemPrompt: You are a fast research assistant. Answer the Planner's question in under 200 words. If the answer needs a code snippet, paste it verbatim — no editorial.
